h1: Product Photo and Video Guides for Sellers Doing It Themselves
lead: Five short guides for one job at a time: a usable phone photo, a plain-background main image, a first paid clip, the right frame, and a fair test.
card: Short how-to guides, from the first photo to the first paid ad.
secondary_keywords: product photography tips for online sellers
how to make product video ads
intro: Each guide ends in a file you download and post yourself. Read the one for the job you are doing today.

A guide can send you to a [template](page:templates), a [product link](page:url-to-video), or a [photo turned into a clip](page:image-to-video). The clip can include an AI presenter from the [actor library](page:ai-actors), a script written from your product, a voiceover in the language you sell in, and captions. You can then publish it to TikTok or Meta. There is no free generation plan.

steps_h2: How to make product video ads or photos
steps_lead: Shoot one clear photo, make the file, then post it.

steps.d: Put the product in daylight on a plain surface and take one sharp phone photo.
Upload the photo or paste a product link, pick a template, and read the credit cost before you start.
Save the file and post it to TikTok, Meta, or your store. Commercial use is allowed, and there is no watermark.

faq.q: Do I need a camera or a studio?
faq.a: No. A phone photo in daylight is enough to start. The photo guide shows the setup.

faq.q: Which guide should I read first?
faq.a: If you do not have a clear photo yet, start with the phone-photo guide. If the photo is ready, open the guide for the job you are posting today.

faq.q: Do platform image and ad rules change?
faq.a: Yes. These guides cover the rules sellers hit most often, such as a plain main image and the usual ad sizes. Check that channel's current help page before you launch.

faq.q: How much do the files in the guides cost?
faq.a: There is no free generation plan. A product photo is 24 credits. A clip is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. The exact cost is shown before every job, and a failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can one source photo feed every guide?
faq.a: Yes, if the photo shows the whole item clearly. You can make a still from it and a clip from it. They are separate jobs.

faq.q: Can I add captions and music later?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for captions or a voiceover in the clip, or add a price and licensed music after download. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Where do I make the file after I read a guide?
faq.a: On the page that guide points to. The guide tells you how to do the job. That page is where you upload the photo and make the file.

faq.q: Can I follow these if I have never run an ad?
faq.a: Yes. You need a phone photo, not a studio. The first-ad guide stops at a file you can post. Your ad account setup stays in that channel's own help pages.

faq.q: Do the guides cover an AI presenter, a script, and a voiceover?
faq.a: Yes. The video guides send you to an actor from the library, a script written from your product or your link, and a voiceover in the language you sell in.

faq.q: Can I post the file on TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Make the frame that channel uses, then publish it there. The [platform pages](page:platforms) list the usual frames.

faq.q: Which kinds of shops are the guides for?
faq.a: The photo job and the video job are the same kind of task across categories. Category rules differ, so check the current page for yours on [industries](page:industries) before you upload.

faq.q: Why read a guide instead of starting from a blank box?
faq.a: The guide names the one job, the file you should end with, and the checks to make before you spend credits on a second try.
